all_found.desc: [BUG] enterableAncestor accepts any path with X_OK, including an executable regular file that replaced a recorded work directory; git cannot run in a file, so ownership lookup fails and the run is attributed to the main checkout. A linked worktree misses its abandoned-run blocker when its run's work dir path is now an executable file.

[ADVISORY] The new tests were inserted between TestMigrateLegacyRowsIsLenientAndRunsOnce's existing doc comment (malformed lines, size stamp) and that function, so that comment now documents TestMigrateLegacyRowsConflictDoesNotStamp and the lenient test has none. Misattributed test documentation misleads readers; no behavioural effect.
